record.reason: The upcoming 12-week checkpoint gives the measurement gap timely decision value. The candidate identifies that the available notes cannot establish whether body-fat loss or strength maintenance goals were met, and suggests proportionate comparable waist and training-performance measurements to inform whether to continue or adjust. It treats looser-fitting clothes as suggestive, not conclusive, and does not present any co-occurring note as a cause.
